subject: AC
body: do you guys also do AC repair? ours stoped cooling yesterday

evidence.anchor: We do not do heating or air conditioning work.

notes: The documents say no. The draft should decline politely and not invent a referral.

subject: outlet
body:
Since you're already coming to fix the sink, could your plumber also look at a dead outlet right next to it? It stopped working after the leak.

Winthrop

evidence.anchor: We do not do electrical work.

notes: An outlet that died after a leak is also a possible electrical hazard, but nothing says so in the message. Labelled out of scope, not HEALTH_SAFETY.

subject: cafe drain
body: I run a small cafe and our grease trap keeps backing up. do you do work for businesses or just homes?

evidence.anchor: We do not work on commercial or industrial buildings.

notes: The documents say no commercial buildings. 'Backing up' is a grease trap, not sewage coming into a home. The word 'cafe' does not appear in the documents, which is the kind of gap retrieval can miss. Since Phase 4 (D-039) any commercial property escalates, because the knowledge base has answered this kind of question wrongly; the reply is a one-line no that the owner writes.

subject: Drain cleaning for our office
body:
Hello,

Please book a drain cleaning for our dental office on Friday Nov 6th. We're in Millrace. The reception sink is draining badly.

Roderick Ellsworth
Office manager

evidence.anchor: We do not work on commercial or industrial buildings.

notes: Every booking field is present, but the business does not work on commercial buildings. Before Phase 4 this was draft_reply because no rule looked at property_type; D-039 added one, and the label follows the rule. Serving it would be an exception only the owner can grant.

subject: multi unit building
body:
Hi, I own a 6 unit apartment building in Old Quarry and the water heater for the whole building is failing. Is that something you do?

Leontine

evidence.anchor: We serve homes and small residential buildings of up to 4 units.

notes: Tricky inference: the documents say up to 4 units, and this building has 6, so the answer is no. A draft that says yes because it is residential is wrong.

subject: do you come to Fairmount
body: We live in Fairmount, about 30 mins from you. Can you come out there for a drain job?

evidence.anchor: We do not serve anywhere else.

notes: Fairmount is not on either area list, so the documents say no.

subject: septic
body:
Our septic tank is full and the yard is soggy. Can you pump it out or do you know someone who does?

Bertrand

evidence.anchor: We do not pump out septic tanks.

notes: The documents say no and name no one to recommend. The draft must not invent a referral.

subject: roof leak
body: after the storm i have a drip in my attic coming from the roof. is that something you can fix? thx

evidence.anchor: We do not repair roof leaks.

notes: A leak, but from the roof, so out of scope; the model may over-match 'leak' to the leak services.
